title: A group of two rectangles
concept: A Group wraps two filled rectangles. The group's ItemTransform composes onto each member, so the cluster moves as one.

annotations.note: The Group element. Its ItemTransform (translate 100 120) is composed onto every member; the parser lifts each child out of the group with the composed transform already applied.
First member: a red Rectangle at the group's local origin. It is a child element of Group, not of Spread.
Second member: a blue Rectangle offset within the group. Both members paint; nothing is skipped.
